turns.speaker: responder
turns.text: Hi Grace, the reference sheet says it's best not to drink alcohol because it can make nausea and vomiting worse. You can still enjoy the party with an alcohol-free drink you like.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: but surely just having a drink would be ok i dont want to stand out

turns.speaker: responder
turns.text: I understand wanting to fit in, but the guidance is still that it's best not to drink. You could choose something alcohol-free and keep your treatment private if you prefer. You don't owe anyone an explanation.
